callouts.label: Toolbar: tools, Play / Pause / Stop, grid and snapping, save, export, settings
Scene: the node tree of the open scene (drag to re-parent, right-click for more)
Viewport: the scene; select, move, rotate and scale nodes
Inspector: the selected node's properties, script and signals
Assets: the project's scenes, scripts, textures, sounds and components
Bottom panel: Console, Animation, Particles, Mixer, Profiler and more
Status bar: project, scene, selection, background tasks
Preview: the selected asset (import settings, sounds, animations)
Game / Level: the scene editor or the LDtk level editor (Cmd+Shift+1 / 2)
